title: Chapter 1861: The West (I)
content:
Chapter 1861: The West (I)

Li Zhouwei nodded slightly. "This is important. The lake has gained many descendants over the years. With Qingdu keeping them in line, they will not go too far astray. What worries me is that they may grow distant from one another. As long as the old elder is here, the four lineages will always have someone who brings them together with kindness and tolerance..."

His words filled Li Ximing with melancholy. Standing in the pavilion, he lowered his eyes and said, "Though I have reached the Purple Mansion Realm, I have few descendants. Those at the lake fear me far more than they feel close to me. Grandfather can reason with them and smooth things over, yet none of these matters ever reach me. If anything should happen to him..."

This was the unbridgeable gulf between those who wielded divine abilities and ordinary people. To a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator, even someone at Foundation Establishment Realm was merely an ant that could be killed with a breath. However much Li Ximing cared about the clan, he could scarcely take a personal interest in its countless juniors. Even when someone attained the Qi Cultivation or Foundation Establishment Realms and was brought before him, he would offer little more than a passing word of praise.

Even his own grandson, Li Zhouming, who had likewise reached the Foundation Establishment Realm, rarely had the chance to see him. Li Xuanxuan, however, cherished them all. Whenever someone broke through, he would summon them for a visit and offer heartfelt words of affection and encouragement. Li Ximing could never do the same.

The Daoist Master stood with his hands behind his back for a while, then said earnestly, "The Li Family owes so much of its survival to the old elder. No one can take his place! I was thinking... if it comes to that, and this Valley Water pill can give grandfather another three to five years... I would gladly use that pill!"

The pill he meant was the [Heavenly Quintessence-Expelling Pill] Tinglan had entrusted to him years ago. Exceptionally precious and made from [Heavenly Origin Essence], it could restore the dead to life and regrow flesh upon bare bones. Taking it could also extend one's lifespan.

Ordinarily, even Purple Mansion Realm cultivators would scramble for such a pill. A few more years of life for one of them could change a great deal. It would never be spent on a Qi Cultivation Realm cultivator. Yet Li Zhouwei showed no surprise.

"Healing injuries is nothing unusual. The [Heavenly Quintessence-Expelling Pill] is precious because it can elevate an Immortal Foundation. Our family has complete cultivation techniques and fine Dao inheritances, with none of those uneven, unorthodox methods. That leaves this as its only use for us. We might as well put it to work."

Li Ximing knew that Li Zhouwei was trying to comfort him. He nodded silently and replied, "Let us try the usual life-extending prescriptions first. I will seek out the old Daoist Master Shanbai of [Horn Wood] and invite him to the lake. We can begin by devising a prescription to improve my grandfather's health."

Li Zhouwei nodded in agreement. "Daoist Nun Xiangchun cannot conveniently come inland, so let us arrange matters at the Zhen Tao Residence instead. Granduncle, please find a reason to take the old elder to the Eastern Sea and bring the pill along. We can ask both of them to examine him and devise a pill recipe together."

It was an impressive gathering of expertise. Only then did Li Ximing feel reassured. "That will be easy. He has never visited the Zhen Tao Residence. Though he says nothing, Li Wen and An Siwei are both there, and he does miss them. I will simply say I am taking him for a visit."

Despite having settled the matter, both felt a deep sadness. Li Xuanxuan's cultivation was too low for many treatments to be possible. Even if they extended his life, it would not be by much. In the Qi Cultivation Realm, even the method Daoist Master Xuanyi had used to create an Artifact Spirit was beyond reach. Moreover, even if it were possible, they would still have to consider the talisman seed within him.

They fell silent for a while. Li Ximing soon changed the subject, recounting his visit to Mount Qusi. "Something significant happened while you were in seclusion. Western Shu suffered a setback in the Great Western Plains. A Daoist Master fell, and Qing Jifang and the others were even injured... To make matters worse, Lacquer Marsh has grown unsettled too."

"

Oh?

"

Li Zhouwei responded with interest as Li Ximing continued, taking evident pleasure in their misfortune, "There is a Sword Immortal Duoling in Lacquer Marsh... Do you remember him?"

Seeing the golden-eyed youth nod, Li Ximing smiled. "This sword immortal is in the middle stage of the Purple Mansion Realm and has been stalled at the Purple Mansion Threshold for a long time. He seems to have made some progress. Once he crosses it, he will become someone capable of shaping the course of the world. Thus, the Qing Family has always left him well alone...

"But something stirred up considerable turmoil in Shu State. At a place called [Sun Seeking Pond], a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator appeared, giving his surname as Xu. He possessed sword intent and had come for revenge. Metal Qi surged across the sky as he took the local prefect's head.

“It was an open challenge to the Qing Family's authority. The Shangguan Family's Purple Mansion Realm cultivator rushed over, and they fought for hours before abruptly breaking off. Only afterward did word emerge that the cultivator backing this man surnamed Xu had intervened to extricate him.

"The affair caused an enormous uproar but ultimately came to nothing. However, rumor has it that the one who intervened was Sword Immortal Duoling."

Li Zhouwei frowned slightly as Li Ximing sighed. "Shu has many swordsmen and has always boasted more sword immortals than any other states. It has declined in recent years, leaving only Duoling. It is hardly surprising that another has now appeared."

Li Zhouwei suddenly recalled the sword immortal he had glimpsed by chance in the grotto heaven and considered. He murmured thoughtfully, "That one wore Shu attire and cultivated Metal Virtue as well. It may be him."

Li Ximing, however, seemed somewhat hesitant. "What particularly caught my attention in this news was the name [Sun Seeking Pond]..."

Li Zhouwei raised his brows as Li Ximing continued, "I hear Daoist Master Guanxue fell at [Sun Seeking Pond]. Daoist Master Donghua's immortal sword was lost there back then as well. Could the fighting there involving two sword immortals be connected to that?"

Li Zhouwei understood at once. There was strong reason to suspect that Daoist Master Donghua, Li Jiangqun, was one of those exalted figures above, so Li Ximing naturally paid closer attention to any related news.

After some thought, he replied, "It is excellent news that Duoling cannot be employed by the Qing Family. Otherwise, the cost of our future campaign against Shu would multiply... As for Sun Seeking Pond... We will attack Shu sooner or later. I shall visit it myself."

Li Ximing nodded to himself and said, "That is simply news worth hearing... I have not been idle while you were in seclusion. Using the [Heavenly Nurturing Urn] as a pretext, I have made extensive inquiries in search of a sacrifice for the green talisman!

"Let us settle this while the situation between north and south is temporarily stable. Otherwise, I fear constant warfare will keep delaying it."

Li Zhouwei's interest stirred. He raised his brows and smiled. "Not easy to find, I imagine!"

Li Ximing shook his head helplessly. "My first thought was still the southern border. The lord of Mount Bifu[1] bears an inherent grudge against our family, making him an excellent target. He also has an early-stage Purple Mansion Realm demon king under him... The problem is that he never leaves the southern border, and his subordinate does not venture far either. Suppressing one of them there would inevitably draw Cen Lufu into action.

"If we were exceptionally lucky and one suddenly left the southern border, we could capture him in the Eastern Sea and secure what we need for the green talisman. But that would put the lord of Mount Bifu on guard, making any future plans against him difficult."

His expression grew serious. "Relying on luck has never been sound planning. Perhaps we could lure him out, but I am keeping the Bifu faction as our last option... It would be best to find what we need elsewhere.

"Most Purple Mansion Realm cultivators in the world have both ability and powerful backing. After making careful inquiries, I have found it a thorny matter. Those in the dragons' hands are out of the question, and there is even less point considering the Northern Sea. The only regions where we might find an opening are probably the southern border, Poluoduo, and the Western Sea."

1. Referring to Cen Lufu. ☜
